kind: Authoring-stage linguistic review, not independent heldout scoring or bilingual certification
global_conditions: Freeze exact source IDs and sense_group metadata; null draft source_group must be repaired in a new version.
Use complete utterances or complete punctuation-delimited sentences; never trim a longer syntactic complement merely to obtain a match.
Preserve communicative force: statement targets must not silently replace question-mark variants. Explicit question templates remain questions; and you/really require terminal question punctuation.
Neutral informal singular tú is a deliberate authored register for one-to-one chat; no claim that English you identifies number/formality in every context.
Constituent dictionary records corroborate lexical choices, not independent full-phrase translations.
Whole-reference availability must remain separate from native beginner-density automatic selection.
